name: chess-pawn
description: A complete chess pawn with a round head and broad base.
useCase: Choose or identify a pawn in a chess interface.
misuse: Pair this symbol with a clear label when its meaning depends on context.

16.reason: The complete round head joins the full tapered stem above a broad open base.

24.reason: The larger pawn keeps its full round head, tapered stem and complete open base.
